raw:
Decision rationale: The abstract describes a system that uses a RAG-enhanced LLaMA model to generate cooking instructions, and it reports experimental results. That counts as proposing a RAG method with experiments. The system takes camera input for ingredient recognition, but the RAG component itself works on text: the generator is conditioned on retrieved recipe text. This is not multimodal-only RAG, so E9 does not apply. Include.

{"decision": "INCLUDE", "code": null, "reason": "Proposes cooking assistant with RAG-enhanced LLaMA and reports experimental results; text retrieval-based generation."}
